semantics.reviewedSeedEvidence: Canonical artist has at least one explicitly reviewed YouTube seed video or belongs to the recoverable historical Product cohort.
semantics.frozenProductScoreAvailable: The existing cutover snapshot contains a production YouTube v3 point for this canonical artist.
semantics.scoreRecomputeEligible: A canonical artist can be scored under a reproducible and comparable seed-selection contract.
semantics.productExpansionEligible: A new canonical artist can safely enter the Product cohort using YouTube evidence without changing score semantics.

blockers.detail: The original complete youtube_seed_videos_v1.csv was never committed. The 47 recovered IDs are known historical approved additions, not proof of the complete production seed.
The 2026-08-31 YouTube v3 cutover snapshot preserves points only and does not preserve videoCount/type breakdown or the full seed input.
Reviewed source identity exists for all 21 candidate artists, but no preserved comparable seed-selection policy exists for recomputing the legacy v3 score across old and new artists.
The 58-video known-approved shadow proves technical collection/scoring execution only. It must not replace frozen Product points or qualify new artists for Product expansion.
